specification.execution_instructions:
You own a bounded design-and-control study. Use only scoped supplied evidence and public tools.
Read study specification, frozen original task, declared capabilities, known historical facts and remaining budgets. Supplied history is not rediscovery.
When mathematical optimization is authorized, use supported task_gap or task_gap_with_effort objective. Explain task difficulty, weights, bounds, fixed variables,
relaxed requirements and expected relation to original completion. Inspect mathematical evidence and returned candidate. Handoff chooses no controller.
Mathematical feasibility, relaxed dynamics and original MuJoCo task acceptance are distinct. Preliminary ranking is optional. Search uses NMPC only.
Choose existing NMPC or direct/residual RL and explain using evidence and budget. Inspect nmpc_admission before launching; no matching timing or oversized
complete execution makes that route unavailable within budget, not the design infeasible. No calibration or raised ceilings.
Residual requires an advertised compatible runnable reference. Direct stays available if incompatible. Train within declared trial/cumulative limits;
query real terminal status and explicitly read/cite its training_summary_reference through evidence_read before deciding.
Evaluate only a usable published checkpoint; otherwise read training/failure evidence and decide without an impossible evaluation or automatic replacement trial.
An earlier checkpoint evaluation must identify its actual training step. Choose rollout-aligned actions; adjustments round down, never above ceilings.
Read independent evaluation evidence explicitly before deciding to adjust control, revise design, switch route, select or stop.
Select a passing development result via confirm selected_execution, freezing candidate+task+route+configuration+exact checkpoint. Use the predeclared fresh
post-selection count. RL confirmation reloads exact weights, fresh simulation, no training or NMPC. Keep failed confirmations; no success-hunting retries.
Selection remains immutable. Nominal repetitions support no robustness claim. No fresh baseline required; withhold improvement attribution without comparable evidence.
Stop once confirmations pass; ceilings are not targets. Preserve all costs including failures. Last protected requests are evidence/STOP only.
STOP cites every new result and follows explicit RL evidence reads and terminal query, with next_step and actual unfinished requirements.
Never include credentials, environment-file contents, unrelated files or personal data in model messages. No algorithm superiority or numerical root-cause claims.

For this new formal study, first explicitly read rl.frozen_task and BOTH historical_evidence.references through evidence_read: the short-training summary and numerical-failure evaluation. Inspect the frozen specification, remaining budget and tools. Do not evaluate the unchanged historical checkpoint again or train it to test reporting. It failed QVEL at action23/substep2 around .2205s; valid prefix .22s, endpoint and holding metrics unavailable. Historical status failure_stage was stale checkpoint-publication metadata; it is not an independent numerical root-cause diagnosis.
Actually invoke research_plan mechanics using supported task_gap or task_gap_with_effort. Explain task difficulty, objective and weights, design bounds, variables/fixed conditions and relaxations. Review its evidence before choosing the candidate/controller route. Mathematical trajectories do not demonstrate original MuJoCo acceptance. NMPC search scoring is NMPC only; inspect configuration-bound admission first. Direct RL needs no reference; residual requires an advertised compatible reference. No artificial prerequisite gate.
After EVERY new trial query public research_rl status, explicitly read its training_summary_reference using evidence_read, evaluate only if a usable published checkpoint exists, then explicitly read the evaluation reference and choose the next action with reasons. If no usable checkpoint exists, read the failure summary and decide; do not request impossible evaluation or automatically start a replacement trial. If evaluating an earlier checkpoint identify actual num_timesteps. Allocation actions must be multiples of selected n_steps; if adjusted, round DOWN and cite requested/effective allocation. No changed-reward/learning-rate inheritance; only new trial/config or same-config resume under original remainder.
Ceilings are 48 provider requests including failures/corrections,160 public operations,2 mathematics attempts at600s each,3 RL trials at200000 actions and1200 active seconds each,600000 cumulative actions and2400 cumulative active seconds,5 RL evaluations including2 reserved fresh confirmations,4 NMPC executions including2 reserved fresh confirmations,1800s per NMPC execution,one optional diagnostic within60s and existing one-step/evidence scope,10800s live including600s delivery reserve. Last4 provider requests protected for evidence/STOP. More training is an experiment, not a known QVEL fix; inspect learning/failure evidence first. Do not fill quotas. Freeze all original task, initialization, physics, execution/acceptance semantics; change only authorized design/controller coordinates. A confirmed solution requires candidate+task+controller+passing development result+two fresh post-selection confirmations; preserve failures, no success-hunting retries. If unmet, stop truthfully and cite all new mathematical/controller results and training summaries. Use original model tool requests and evidence citations; no manufactured decisions.
